transcript.text: Hi Test: Honest junior, this is Donna, an AI assistant calling for Alex at Acme (demo). This call is recorded. I saw your work on a Redis-backed rate limiter library. Got a few minutes for a quick screen for the Founding Engineer role?
Great, thanks. Your rate limiter claims 50k requests per second. How did you measure that, and what broke first?
I built a smaller version of a Redis rate limiter for a side project, a sliding window with a sorted set, but I never measured anything close to 50k requests per second.
Thanks for being straight about that. What did you actually measure, even roughly, and what broke first when you ran it?
Honestly I only tested it with a few hundred requests a second from a local script, so I can't tell you where it would break first.
Thanks, that's useful to know. On the payments team, what went wrong with idempotency keys, and how did you find out?
I haven't worked on a payments team; I've only read the payments code in an open source project, where the idempotency key was stored with the response so a retry returned the same result.
Storing the response alongside the key is a solid pattern, and it's useful to know you've read that code closely. If you joined tomorrow, what would you want to own in your first two weeks?
In my first two weeks I'd pair with someone on the API, fix a couple of small bugs, and learn how deploys and monitoring work before owning anything bigger.

Makes sense, learning the deploy and monitoring path before taking on something bigger is a sensible order. Thanks, Test: Honest junior. I'll pass my notes to Alex, and you'll get a calendar invite if they'd like to meet.

elevenLabsAnalysis.transcript_summary: An AI agent conducted a screening call for a Founding Engineer role. The agent questioned the candidate about their Redis-backed rate limiter's performance claims and experience with idempotency keys. The candidate clarified that their rate limiter was only tested locally at lower rates and their idempotency key knowledge came from open-source code. The candidate proposed a sensible plan for their first two weeks, focusing on learning and small bug fixes. The agent concluded by stating notes would be passed to Alex for potential next steps.
